mapper.select: SELECT v.billing_year AS year, v.billing_month AS month, COUNT(*) AS bill_count, COALESCE(SUM(v.receivable_amount), 0) AS receivable_amount, COALESCE(SUM(v.received_amount), 0) AS received_amount, COALESCE(SUM(v.outstanding_amount), 0) AS outstanding_amount, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(v.received_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(v.receivable_amount), 0) * 100, 2), 0) AS collection_rate_percent FROM v_bill_financial_summary v JOIN property_unit pu ON pu.property_unit_id = v.property_unit_id JOIN building_unit bu ON bu.building_unit_id = pu.building_unit_id JOIN building b ON b.building_id = bu.building_id WHERE v.billing_year = #{year} GROUP BY v.billing_year, v.billing_month ORDER BY v.billing_month

SELECT #{year} AS year, COUNT(*) AS bill_count, COALESCE(SUM(v.receivable_amount), 0) AS receivable_amount, COALESCE(SUM(v.received_amount), 0) AS received_amount, COALESCE(SUM(v.outstanding_amount), 0) AS outstanding_amount, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(v.received_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(v.receivable_amount), 0) * 100, 2), 0) AS collection_rate_percent FROM v_bill_financial_summary v JOIN property_unit pu ON pu.property_unit_id = v.property_unit_id JOIN building_unit bu ON bu.building_unit_id = pu.building_unit_id JOIN building b ON b.building_id = bu.building_id WHERE v.billing_year = #{year}

SELECT CEILING(v.billing_month / 3) AS quarter, COUNT(*) AS bill_count, COALESCE(SUM(v.receivable_amount), 0) AS receivable_amount, COALESCE(SUM(v.received_amount), 0) AS received_amount, COALESCE(SUM(v.outstanding_amount), 0) AS outstanding_amount, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(v.received_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(v.receivable_amount), 0) * 100, 2), 0) AS collection_rate_percent FROM v_bill_financial_summary v JOIN property_unit pu ON pu.property_unit_id = v.property_unit_id JOIN building_unit bu ON bu.building_unit_id = pu.building_unit_id JOIN building b ON b.building_id = bu.building_id WHERE v.billing_year = #{year} GROUP BY CEILING(v.billing_month / 3) ORDER BY quarter

SELECT ft.fee_code, ft.fee_name, COALESCE(SUM(bi.amount), 0) AS receivable_amount FROM bill b JOIN bill_item bi ON bi.bill_id = b.bill_id JOIN fee_standard fs ON fs.fee_standard_id = bi.fee_standard_id JOIN fee_type ft ON ft.fee_type_id = fs.fee_type_id JOIN property_unit pu ON pu.property_unit_id = b.property_unit_id JOIN building_unit bu ON bu.building_unit_id = pu.building_unit_id JOIN building bl ON bl.building_id = bu.building_id WHERE b.billing_year = #{year} GROUP BY ft.fee_type_id, ft.fee_code, ft.fee_name ORDER BY receivable_amount DESC

SELECT b.status, COUNT(*) AS bill_count FROM bill b JOIN property_unit pu ON pu.property_unit_id = b.property_unit_id JOIN building_unit bu ON bu.building_unit_id = pu.building_unit_id JOIN building bl ON bl.building_id = bu.building_id WHERE b.billing_year = #{year} GROUP BY b.status ORDER BY b.status

SELECT pu.occupancy_status, COUNT(*) AS property_count FROM property_unit pu JOIN building_unit bu ON bu.building_unit_id = pu.building_unit_id JOIN building b ON b.building_id = bu.building_id WHERE 1 = 1 GROUP BY pu.occupancy_status ORDER BY pu.occupancy_status

SELECT c.community_id, c.community_name, COUNT(*) AS bill_count, COALESCE(SUM(v.receivable_amount), 0) AS receivable_amount, COALESCE(SUM(v.received_amount), 0) AS received_amount, COALESCE(SUM(v.outstanding_amount), 0) AS outstanding_amount, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(v.received_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(v.receivable_amount), 0) * 100, 2), 0) AS collection_rate_percent FROM v_bill_financial_summary v JOIN property_unit pu ON pu.property_unit_id = v.property_unit_id JOIN building_unit bu ON bu.building_unit_id = pu.building_unit_id JOIN building b ON b.building_id = bu.building_id JOIN community c ON c.community_id = b.community_id WHERE v.billing_year = #{year} AND v.billing_month = #{month} GROUP BY c.community_id, c.community_name ORDER BY c.community_code, c.community_id

SELECT #{year} AS year, #{month} AS month, COUNT(*) AS bill_count, COALESCE(SUM(v.receivable_amount), 0) AS receivable_amount, COALESCE(SUM(v.received_amount), 0) AS received_amount, COALESCE(SUM(v.outstanding_amount), 0) AS outstanding_amount, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(v.received_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(v.receivable_amount), 0) * 100, 2), 0) AS collection_rate_percent FROM v_bill_financial_summary v JOIN property_unit pu ON pu.property_unit_id = v.property_unit_id JOIN building_unit bu ON bu.building_unit_id = pu.building_unit_id JOIN building b ON b.building_id = bu.building_id WHERE v.billing_year = #{year} AND v.billing_month = #{month} AND b.community_id = #{communityId}
SELECT community_name FROM community c WHERE c.community_id = #{communityId} AND c.community_id IN #{scopeId} AND 1 = 0

SELECT ft.fee_code, ft.fee_name, COALESCE(SUM(bi.amount), 0) AS receivable_amount FROM bill b JOIN bill_item bi ON bi.bill_id = b.bill_id JOIN fee_standard fs ON fs.fee_standard_id = bi.fee_standard_id JOIN fee_type ft ON ft.fee_type_id = fs.fee_type_id JOIN property_unit pu ON pu.property_unit_id = b.property_unit_id JOIN building_unit bu ON bu.building_unit_id = pu.building_unit_id JOIN building bl ON bl.building_id = bu.building_id WHERE b.billing_year = #{year} AND b.billing_month = #{month} AND bl.community_id = #{communityId} GROUP BY ft.fee_type_id, ft.fee_code, ft.fee_name ORDER BY receivable_amount DESC

SELECT b.status, COUNT(*) AS bill_count FROM bill b JOIN property_unit pu ON pu.property_unit_id = b.property_unit_id JOIN building_unit bu ON bu.building_unit_id = pu.building_unit_id JOIN building bl ON bl.building_id = bu.building_id WHERE b.billing_year = #{year} AND b.billing_month = #{month} AND bl.community_id = #{communityId} GROUP BY b.status ORDER BY b.status
